actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Arm Spine Regrowth
abilities.desc: The erina has twenty-four arm spines that it can use to make Throw Spine attacks. Used spines regrow when it finishes a long rest.

abilities.name: Expert Wrestler
abilities.desc: The erina can grapple creatures two sizes larger than itself and can move at its full speed when dragging a creature it has grappled. If it grapples a Small or smaller creature target has disadvantage on its escape attempts. Erina has advantage on ability checks and saves made to escape a grapple or end restrained condition.

abilities.name: Keen Smell
abilities.desc: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

abilities.name: Hardy
abilities.desc: The erina has advantage on saves vs. poison.

abilities.name: Spines
abilities.desc: A creature that touches erina or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage. A creature grappled by or grappling erina takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage at start of the erina's turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Two Punching Spines or Throw Spines. If it hits one creature with both Punching Spines target is grappled (escape DC 13). Erina can grapple only one target at a time.

actions.name: Punching Spines
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (2d4+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Throw Spine
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit 20/60' one target 8 (2d4+3) piercing damage and spine sticks in target until a creature uses an action to remove it. While spine is stuck target has disadvantage on weapon attacks that use Str.

name: Erinyes
resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

abilities.name: Hellish Weapons
abilities.desc: The erinyes's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 13 (3d8) poison damage on a hit (included in the attacks).

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The erinyes has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The erinyes makes three attacks

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. The poison lasts until it is removed by the lesser restoration spell or similar magic.

actions.name: Variant: Rope of Entanglement
actions.desc: Some erinyes carry a rope of entanglement (detailed in the Dungeon Master's Guide). When such an erinyes uses its Multiattack, the erinyes can use the rope in place of two of the attacks.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the erinyes must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Erinyes
resistances: cold; damage from nonmagical, non-silvered weapons

abilities.name: Lawful Evil
abilities.desc: The erinyes radiates a Lawful and Evil aura.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The erinyes has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The erinyes makes three attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage  and the target makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is poisoned for 24 hours or until the poison is removed by lesser restoration or similar magic.

actions.name: Lasso
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: The target is entangled by the lasso. While entangled  it can't move more than 15 feet away from the erinyes. The entanglement ends if the erinyes releases the lasso or becomes incapacitated  or if the lasso is destroyed. The lasso is an object with AC 12 and 20 HP and is immune to piercing  poison  psychic  and thunder damage. The entanglement also ends if the target or a creature within 5 feet of it uses an action to succeed on a DC 16 Athletics or Acrobatics check to remove the lasso. The erinyes can't make a lasso attack while a creature is entangled.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: If the erinyes is wielding a longsword and can see its attacker, it adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.desc: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Web Sense
abilities.desc: While in contact with a web, the ettercap knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

abilities.name: Web Walker
abilities.desc: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ettercap makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Web (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 11 Strength check, escaping from the webbing on a success. The effect ends if the webbing is destroyed. The webbing has AC 10, 5 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage and immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage.

actions.name: Variant: Web Garrote
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or Small creature against which the ettercap has advantage on the attack roll. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target can't breathe, and the ettercap has advantage on attack rolls against it.

abilities.name: Speak with Spiders
abilities.desc: The ettercap can communicate with spiders that can hear it or that are touching the same web.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.desc: The ettercap can use its climb speed even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

abilities.name: Web Sense
abilities.desc: While touching a web, the ettercap knows the location of other creatures touching that web.

abilities.name: Web Walker
abilities.desc: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions imposed by webs.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ettercap attacks with its bite and claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Strangle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature against which the ettercap has advantage on the attack roll. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends  the ettercap automatically hits the target with its strangle attack  and the target can't breathe.

bonusActions.name: Web
bonusActions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is restrained by webs. As an action, a creature can make a DC 11 Strength check, breaking the webs on a success. The effect also ends if the webs are destroyed. They have AC 10, 1 hit point, and immunity to all damage except slashing, fire, and force.

abilities.name: Two Heads
abilities.desc: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

abilities.name: Wakeful
abilities.desc: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ettin makes two attacks: one with its battleaxe and one with its morningstar.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Reactive Heads
abilities.desc: The ettin can take two reactions each round, but not more than one per turn.

abilities.name: Two Heads
abilities.desc: While both heads are awake, the ettin has advantage on Perception checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious, and it can't be flanked.

abilities.name: Wakeful
abilities.desc: When one of the ettins heads is asleep, the other is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ettin makes a battleaxe attack and a club attack.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature and the ettin is bloodied  the target makes a DC 15 Strength check and is knocked prone on a failure.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Axe Whirl
actions.desc: The ettin makes a battleaxe attack against each creature within 10 feet.

abilities.name: Bickering Heads
abilities.desc: A kobold ettin's constant bickering can be easily heard and proves a tough habit to disrupt. It has disadvantage on Dex (Stealth) checks to stay silent but it has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks. Has advantage vs. being blinded charmed deafened frightened stunned and knocked unconscious.

abilities.name: Might of Giants
abilities.desc: Though squat by ettin standards kobold ettins are as much giant as they are kobold. It is a Large Giant for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.desc: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.desc: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Two Greatclub or Spear attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d8+3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit 5 ft. or range 20/60' one target 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage or 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Echoing Burps (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Tries to let loose double roar but instead sends forth a series of obnoxious smelly belches in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area: 10 (4d4) thunder and is incapacitated until end of its next turn (DC 13 Con half damage and isn't incapacitated).

abilities.name: Healed by Blood
abilities.desc: Whenever a creature is reduced to 0 hp within 60 feet of the execrable shrub, the shrub regains 5 (1d10) hp.

abilities.name: Like Calls to Like
abilities.desc: The execrable shrub knows if a creature within 60 feet of it is evil-aligned or not.

abilities.name: Limited Telepathy
abilities.desc: Using telepathy, the execrable shrub can magically communicate with any other evil-aligned creature within 100 feet of it. This communication is primarily through images and emotions rather than actual words.

actions.name: Burning Slash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

actions.name: Smolder
actions.desc: The execrable shrub releases a billowing cloud of smoke in a 10-foot-radius that lasts for 1 minute and moves with the shrub. The area affected by the smoke is heavily obscured.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.desc: The toad can breathe air and water.

abilities.name: Final Croak
abilities.desc: When the toad is reduced to 0 hp, it explodes in a 10-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in the area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

abilities.name: Mad Hopping
abilities.desc: Ranged attacks against the toad have disadvantage.

abilities.name: Selective Immunity
abilities.desc: When an attack or effect deals fire damage to the toad, the toad can choose to take the fire damage as if it were not immune.

abilities.name: Standing Leap
abilities.desc: The toad's long jump is up to 10 feet and its high jump is up to 5 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Death Leap
reactions.desc: The exploding toad can turn an attack that missed it into a hit or turn a successful saving throw into a failure.

name: Eye Golem
immunities: poison, psychic, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t speak

abilities.name: Blinding Demise
abilities.desc: When the golem reduces a creature to 0 hp, it can blind the creature permanently. If it does so, the creature is reduced to 1 hp instead.

abilities.name: Construct Nature
abilities.desc: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

abilities.name: Immutable Form
abilities.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

abilities.name: Light-Infused Fists
abilities.desc: The golem's Slam attacks are magical. When the golem hits with a Slam attack, the attack deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eye golem can use its Primal Voice of Doom. It then makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Gaze of Ancient Light (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The golem opens all of its eyes and emits a burst of blinding light. Each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (10d6) radiant damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also stunned until the end of its next turn. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Primal Voice of Doom
actions.desc: The golem intones a disturbing invocation of the sun god at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Eye of the Gods
resistances: fire, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

abilities.name: Blazing Nimbus
abilities.desc: A hostile creature that touches the eye of the gods or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) radiant (good or neutral eyes) or necrotic (evil eyes) damage.

abilities.name: Corona of Truth
abilities.desc: Allies within 10 feet of the eye of the gods have truesight of 20 feet.

abilities.name: Divine Conduit
abilities.desc: The deity that created the eye of the gods can see everything the eye sees and can instantly recall the eye to its side at any time.

abilities.name: Ethereal Jaunt
abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the eye of the gods can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

actions.name: Divine Inspiration
actions.desc: The eye of the gods inspires all allies within 10 feet. For 1 minute, all inspired creatures have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) radiant (good or neutral eyes) or necrotic (evil eyes) damage.

name: Fabricator
resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 16
languages: understands Common, Deep Speech, and Draconic but can’t speak

abilities.name: Assemble
abilities.desc: With at least 10 minutes of work, a fabricator can refine raw materials and create entirely new objects by combining material it has absorbed. For example, it can create a rope from absorbed hemp, clothing from absorbed flax or wool, and a longsword from absorbed metal. A fabricator can create intricate objects like thieves' tools and objects with moving parts with at least 1 hour of work and twice the requisite raw materials, but it can't create magic items. The quality of objects it creates is commensurate with the quality of the raw materials.

abilities.name: Dismantling Form
abilities.desc: A creature that touches the fabricator or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) force damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or once-living material (such as bone or wood) that hits the fabricator is slowly dismantled by the minute constructs that make up the fabricator. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or once-living material that hits the fabricator is destroyed after dealing damage. At the start of each of its turns, the fabricator can choose whether this trait is active.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fabricator makes two disassembling slam attacks.

actions.name: Disassembling Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hp by this attack immediately dies and its body and nonmagical equipment is disassembled and absorbed into the fabricator. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a wish spell. The fabricator can choose to not disassemble a creature or its equipment after reducing it to 0 hp.

abilities.name: Memory Loss
abilities.desc: A creature that sees or interacts with a faceless wanderer must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw 1 minute after the faceless wanderer leaves. On a failure, the details of the faceless wanderer and the events surrounding its appearance rapidly fade away from the creature's mind, including the presence of the faceless wanderer.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.desc: The faceless wanderer regains 5 hp at the start of its turn. If a creature hasn't failed the saving throw of the faceless wanderer's Memory Drain within the last 1 minute, this trait doesn't function until a creature fails it. If a faceless wanderer is reduced to 0 hp while it is still capable of regenerating, its body dissipates into vapor and reforms 1d10 days later somewhere in the Void. Otherwise, it is permanently destroyed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The faceless wanderer makes two attacks, but it can use its Memory Drain only once.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Memory Drain
actions.desc: The faceless wanderer drains memories from an adult creature within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage and its Intelligence score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Intelligence to 0. A humanoid slain in this way rises 1d4 hours later as a new faceless wanderer. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. On a success, the target takes half the damage and its Intelligence score isn't reduced.

name: Faerie Dragon
languages: Draconic, Sylvan, telepathy 60 ft. (with other dragons only)

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.desc:
The dragons innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast spells, requiring no material components. The dragon gains additional spells as it ages:

- **5 years old, at will:** Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion
- **10 years old, 1/Day**: Suggestion
- **30 years old, 1/Day**: Major Image
- **50 years old, 1/Day**: Hallucinatory Terrain

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

actions.name: Euphoria Breath
actions.desc: The dragon breathes an intoxicating gas at a creature within 5 feet. The target makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is confused for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Prismatic Light
actions.desc: The dragons scales pulse with light. Each creature within 15 feet that can see the dragon makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is magically blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Beast Form
actions.desc: The dragon targets one creature within 15 feet. The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is magically transformed into a harmless Tiny beast  such as a mouse or a songbird  for 1 minute. While in this form  its statistics are unchanged  except it can't speak or take actions  reactions  or

bonusActions.name: Invisibility
bonusActions.desc: The dragon and any equipment it wears or carries magically turns invisible. This invisibility ends if the dragon falls unconscious, dismisses the effect, or uses Bite, Euphoria Breath, Prismatic Light, or Beast Form.

name: Faerie Dragon Familiar
languages: Draconic, Sylvan, telepathy 60 ft. (with other dragons only)

- **30 years old, 1/Day**: Major Image
- **50 years old, 1/Day**: Hallucinatory Terrain

actions.desc: The dragons scales pulse with light. Each creature within 15 feet that can see the dragon makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is magically blinded until the end of its next turn.

While in this form  its statistics are unchanged  except it can't speak or take actions  reactions  or

abilities.name: 1-4: Arm
abilities.desc: If the troll has an arm, it loses an arm. It loses one of its claw attacks, and the severed arm can make a claw attack.

abilities.name: 5-6: Head
abilities.desc: If the troll has a head, it loses its head. It loses its bite attack, and the severed head can make a bite attack.

abilities.name: Keen Smell
abilities.desc: The troll has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The troll has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.desc: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesnt function on its next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesnt regenerate.

abilities.name: Severed Limbs
abilities.desc: If the troll is dealt a critical hit with a slashing weapon, one of its extremities is severed. The extremity has AC 15, 10 hit points, a Speed of 10, and the trolls Regeneration trait. The troll controls the severed extremity and perceives through it with the appropriate senses (for instance, it sees through the eyes of its severed head). As a bonus action, the troll can reattach the extremity. While the troll is missing the extremity, its maximum hit points are reduced by 10. Roll d6 to determine the severed extremity:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troll attacks with its bite and twice with its claw. When the troll uses Multiattack  it can use Charming Murmur in place of its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Charming Murmur
actions.desc: One creature within 60 feet that can hear the troll makes a DC 12 Charisma saving throw. On a failure  it is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed  its Speed is 0. The creature repeats the saving throw whenever it takes damage.

abilities.name: Faerie Form
abilities.desc: The noble can magically change its size between Large, Medium, and Tiny as an action. While Tiny, the bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by the nobles attacks is halved. Additionally, it has disadvantage on Strength checks and advantage on Dexterity checks. While Large, the noble has advantage on Strength checks. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

abilities.name: Faerie Light
abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the noble can cast dim light for 30 feet, or extinguish its glow.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.desc:
The nobles spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** Animal Messenger, Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Disguise Self
- **3/Day Each:** Charm Person, Scrying, Zone of Truth,
- **1/Day Each:** Dream, Geas, Heroes Feast, Magic Circle, Polymorph (self only)

actions.name: Evil Eye (Gaze)
actions.desc: The noble targets one creature not under the effect of a faeries Evil Eye within 60 feet. The target makes a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw  the noble chooses one of the following effects to magically impose on the target. Each effect lasts for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The noble makes two glittering scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Glittering Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold  fire  lightning  or psychic damage (its choice).

actions.name: Gleaming Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. This attack ignores half or three-quarters cover. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) cold  fire  lightning  or psychic damage (its choice).

actions.name: The target falls asleep
actions.desc: This effect ends if the target takes damage or another creature uses an action to rouse it.

actions.name: The target is frightened
actions.desc: This effect ends if the target is ever 60 feet or more from the noble.

actions.name: The target is poisoned
actions.desc: It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Faerie Step
bonusActions.desc: The noble magically teleports up to 60 feet to a space it can see.

reactions.name: Riposte
reactions.desc: When the noble is hit by a melee attack made by a creature it can see, it makes a glittering scimitar attack against the attacker.

reactions.name: Vengeful Eye
reactions.desc: When the noble is hit by a ranged attack or targeted with a spell by a creature within 60 feet, it uses Evil Eye on the attacker if they can see each other.

abilities.name: Aligned
abilities.desc: An angel radiates a Lawful aura. Most angels also radiate a Good aura, and a few radiate Evil.

abilities.name: Celestial Dissolution
abilities.desc: When an angel dies, its body and equipment dissolve into motes of light.

abilities.name: Detect Alignment
abilities.desc: An angel knows the alignment, if any, of each creature within 30 feet that it can see.

abilities.name: Immortal Nature
abilities.desc: An angel doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deva makes two attacks.

actions.name: Celestial Hammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (5d6) radiant damage. On a hit  the target can't make opportunity attacks against the deva until the beginning of the targets next turn.

actions.name: Divine Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Energy
actions.desc: The deva touches a creature other than itself. If the target is unwilling  the deva makes an attack roll with a +8 bonus. The deva can choose to magically heal 60 hit points of damage and end any blindness  curse  deafness  disease  or poison on the target. Alternatively  the deva can choose to deal 60 radiant damage to the target.

actions.name: Change Form
actions.desc: The deva magically transforms into a beast or humanoid or back into its true form. It retains its deva statistics  including speech and telepathy  except that it has the size  movement modes  and traits of its new form.

actions.name: Consume Life Energy
actions.desc: The angel feasts on the departing life energy of a humanoid within 5 feet. The target must have been slain within the last hour. The angel magically gains temporary hit points equal to half the dead creatures maximum hit points. These hit points last until depleted. Only a spell cast with a 9th-level slot can raise the corpse from the dead.

abilities.name: Champion of Truth
abilities.desc: The planetar automatically detects lies. Additionally, it cannot lie.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.desc:
The planetars spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20). The planetar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **1/Day Each:** Commune, Control Weather, Raise Dead

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The planetar attacks twice with its flaming sword.

actions.name: Flaming Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) ongoing fire or radiant damage (the planetars choice). A creature can use an action to extinguish this holy flame on itself or a creature within 5 feet.

actions.name: Heavenly Bolt
actions.desc: The planetar fires a lightning bolt in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw  taking 56 (16d6) lightning damage on a failed save  or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Heal
actions.desc: The planetar touches a creature other than itself  magically healing 60 hit points of damage and ending any blindness  curse  deafness  disease  or poison on the target.

actions.name: Consume Life Energy
actions.desc: The angel feasts on the departing life energy of a humanoid within 5 feet. The target must have been slain within the last hour. The angel magically gains temporary hit points equal to half the dead creatures maximum hit points. These hit points last until depleted. Only a spell cast with a 9th-level slot can raise the corpse from the dead.

bonusActions.name: Awe-Inspiring Gaze
bonusActions.desc: The planetar targets a creature within 90 feet. The target makes a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened until the end of its next turn. If the target makes its saving throw, it is immune to any angels Awe-Inspiring Gaze for the next 24 hours.

reactions.name: Protective Parry
reactions.desc: When a creature within 5 feet would be hit with a melee attack, the planetar applies disadvantage to the attack roll.

abilities.name: Champion of Truth
abilities.desc: The solar automatically detects lies. Additionally, it cannot lie.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.desc:
The solars spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). The solar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **1/Day Each:** Commune, Control Weather, Resurrection

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The solar attacks twice with its holy sword.

actions.name: Holy Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Column of Flame
actions.desc: Flame erupts in a 10-foot-radius  30-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point the solar can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature in the area makes a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage and 21 (6d6) radiant damage of a failure  or half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Consume Life Energy
actions.desc: The angel feasts on the departing life energy of a humanoid within 5 feet. The target must have been slain within the last hour. The angel magically gains temporary hit points equal to half the dead creatures maximum hit points. These hit points last until depleted. Only a spell cast with a 9th-level slot can raise the corpse from the dead.

reactions.name: Forceful Parry
reactions.desc: When a creature misses the solar with a melee attack, the solars parrying sword sparks with energy. The attacker takes 21 (6d6) lightning damage and makes a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is pushed 10 feet away and falls prone.

legendaryActions.name: The solar can take 3 legendary actions
legendaryActions.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. The solar regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.desc: The solar magically teleports up to 120 feet to an empty space it can see.

legendaryActions.name: Heal
legendaryActions.desc: The solar touches a creature other than itself, magically healing 60 hit points of damage and ending any blindness, curse, deafness, disease, or poison on the target.

legendaryActions.name: Deafening Command (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The solar speaks an echoing command. Each creature of the solars choice within 30 feet that can hear the solar and understands a language makes a DC 24 Charisma saving throw. Each creature that succeeds on the saving throw takes 21 (6d6) thunder damage. Each creature that fails its saving throw immediately takes a certain action, depending on the solars command. This is a magical charm effect.

legendaryActions.name: Abase yourself! The creature falls prone
Approach! The creature must use its reaction
Flee! The creature must use its reaction
Surrender! The creature drops anything it is holding

name: Falsifier Fog
resistances: acid, cold, fire, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
conditionImmunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 13

abilities.name: Enveloping Fog
abilities.desc: The falsifier fog can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the falsifier fog can move through any opening as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The fog's space is lightly obscured, and a creature in the fog's space has threequarters cover against attacks and other effects outside the fog.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.desc: While the falsifier fog hovers motionlessly, it is indistinguishable from ordinary fog.

abilities.name: Horrific Illusions
abilities.desc: A creature that starts its turn in the falsifier fog's space must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of its next turn, as it sees visions of its worst fears within the fog. While frightened, a creature's speed is reduced to 0. If a creature fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is afflicted with short-term madness.

abilities.name: Limited Telepathy
abilities.desc: The falsifier fog can communicate telepathically with any creature in its space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The falsifier fog makes two chill attacks.

actions.name: Chill
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target in the fog's space. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Reaching Phantasms (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The phantasmal images within the falsifier fog reach outward. Each creature within 10 feet of the fog must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures in the fog's space have disadvantage on the saving throw.

name: Fane Spirit
resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons
conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
languages: any languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
abilities.desc: The fane spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

abilities.name: Veil of the Living
abilities.desc:
During the day a fane spirit appears much as it did in life and loses its Incorporeal Movement trait, its Touch of Forgetfulness action, and its immunity to being grappled and restrained. It retains all other statistics. While in this form, it has a Strength score of 10. If attacked in this form, it relies on its spells to defend itself, but it reverts to its undead form as soon as it takes any damage.

When the sun sets or when it takes any damage, the fane spirit assumes its undead form, and it has all of its listed statistics. Any creature witnessing this transformation must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of its next turn. A fane spirit reverts to its living form in the morning, though creatures witnessing this don't need to make saving throws.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.desc:
The fane spirit's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: chill touch, spare the dying
3/day each: cure wounds, inflict wounds, shield of faith
1/day each: augury, hold person, lesser restoration

actions.name: Touch of Forgetfulness
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic damage. A target hit by this attack must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or forget any or all events that happened up to 5 minutes prior to this attack, as if affected by the modify memory spell. The GM decides how this affects the target.

abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
abilities.desc: The worg has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13) if the worg isn't already grapping a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the worg can't bite another target.

actions.name: Might of the Great Wolf
actions.desc:
The fang of the Great Wolf grows in size. This works like the enlarge/reduce spell, except the worg can only enlarge and it lasts for 1 minute. While enlarged, the fang of the Great Wolf gains the following action:
Swallow. The worg makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worg, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worg's turns. The worg can have only one creature swallowed at a time. 

If the worg takes 10 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the worg must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the worg. The creature is automatically regurgitated when the worg is no longer enlarged. If the worg dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The far darrig makes two Antler Glaive attacks.

actions.name: Antler Glaive
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage or slashing damage (the far darrig's choice) plus 3 (1d6) force damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Woodland Friends (1/Day)
actions.desc: The far darrig magically calls 1d4 elk or giant weasels. The called Beasts arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the far darrig and obeying its spoken commands. The Beasts remain for 1 hour, until the far darrig dies, or until the far darrig dismisses them as a bonus action.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Woodsman
bonusActions.desc: The far darrig takes the Dash or Disengage action. The far darrig can use this bonus action only if it is in a forest.

name: Far Dorocha
acDesc: natural armor), 18 while in dim light or darkness
resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

abilities.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)
abilities.desc: As a bonus action while in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the far dorocha disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this trait.

abilities.name: Traveler in Darkness
abilities.desc: The far dorocha has advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks made to know about shadow roads and shadow magic spells or items.

abilities.name: Under the Cloak of Night
abilities.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the far dorocha's AC includes its Charisma modifier, and it has advantage on saving throws.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.desc:
The far dorocha's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.
At will: disguise self, thaumaturgy
3/day each: command, phantom steed
1/day each: compulsion, darkness

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The far dorocha makes two dirk attacks.

actions.name: Dirk
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Dark Invitation
actions.desc:
One humanoid within 30 feet of the far dorocha and that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 day. The charmed target believes it has been invited to meet with the far dorocha's master and accompanies the far dorocha. Although the target isn't under the far dorocha's control, it takes the far dorocha's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. Each time the far dorocha or its companions do anything harmful to the target, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect ends if the far dorocha is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or uses its bonus action to end the effect. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the far dorocha's Dark Invitation for the next 24 hours.

The far dorocha can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

abilities.name: Trader
abilities.desc: The far wanderer understands the literal meaning of any spoken or written language it hears or reads. In addition, it can use an action to read the surface thoughts of one creature within 30 feet. This works like the detect thoughts spell, except it can only read surface thoughts and there is no limit to the duration. It can end this effect as a bonus action or by using an action to change the target.

abilities.name: Traveler
abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the far wanderer folds the fabric of reality to teleport itself to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A brief shimmer of starlight appears at the origin and destination.

actions.name: Call to Yorama
actions.desc: The far wanderer channels the energy of the living god-star Yorama. One creature the far wanderer can see within 60 feet must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who fails the saving throw is stunned until the end of its turn. Alternately, the far wanderer can instead restore 14 (4d6) hp to one willing creature it can see within 60 feet.

actions.name: Stardust Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) slashing damage and 2 (1d4) cold damage.

actions.name: Stardust bow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and 2 (1d4) cold damage.

name: Fate Eater
languages: understands all but can’t speak, telepathy 100 ft.

abilities.name: Visionary Flesh
abilities.desc: A creature that eats the flesh of a fate eater must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is poisoned for 1 hour. On a success, the creature gains the benefits of the divination spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fate eater makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Alter Fate (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The fate eater alters the fate of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 36 (8d8) psychic damage, and its fate is altered. Roll a d6 to determine which of the following alterations affects the creature. On a success, the creature takes half the damage, and its fate isn't altered. A creature with an altered fate for 1 minute or less can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, a creature with an altered fate can repeat the saving throw at the end of each long rest, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Faux-Garou
conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
languages: understands creator's languages but can't speak

abilities.name: Construct Nature
abilities.desc: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

abilities.name: Druidic Vengeance
abilities.desc: Knows scent and appearance of each creature it was created to kill. Advantage on attacks vs. such creatures and on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find and track them.

abilities.name: Immutable Form
abilities.desc: Immune: form-altering spells/effects.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

abilities.name: Necrotic Weapons
abilities.desc: Weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals extra 3d6 necrotic (included below).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Uses Frightening Gaze then two Claws.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage + 10 (3d6) necrotic.

actions.name: Frightening Gaze
actions.desc: Fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 60' of it. Target frightened 1 min (DC 15 Wis negates). Creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. If save succeeds or effect ends for it creature immune to faux-garou's Frightening Gaze for the next 24 hrs.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.desc: Transforms into Large or smaller Beast matching type of lycanthrope it resembles (wolf if it resembles a werewolf etc.) or back into its true form. Its stats other than size and speed are same in each form. While transformed retains constructed appearance and claws at end of its forelimbs. Items worn or carried not transformed. Reverts to true form if it dies.

name: Fear Liath
languages: any languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Gray Curse
abilities.desc: If remove curse is cast upon a fear liath, it is instantly destroyed. In addition, if the fear liath kills a humanoid creature, the fear liath is destroyed and the humanoid it killed rises as a fear liath in 1d4 hours. If remove curse is cast upon the cursed humanoid before it becomes a fear liath, the curse is broken.

abilities.name: Unwatchable
abilities.desc:
The fear liath becomes incorporeal and appears as a dark gray shadow while any living creature looks directly at it. While incorporeal, it can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object. While incorporeal, it also gains resistance to acid, fire, lightning, and thunder damage, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. The fear liath has no control over this trait.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid looking directly at the fear liath at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the fear liath until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If a creature looks at the fear liath, the fear liath becomes incorporeal.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Fear Smith
resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from attacks not made with cold iron weapons

abilities.name: Distortion Gaze
abilities.desc: Those who meet the gaze of the fear smith experience the world seeming to twist at unnatural angles beneath their feet. When a creature that can see the fear smith's eye starts its turn within 30 feet of the fear smith, the fear smith can force the creature to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw if the fear smith isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. On a failed save, the creature is disoriented until the start of its next turn. While disoriented, a creature can't take the Dash or Disengage action, and when it moves for the first time on its turn, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

abilities.name: Hidden Eye
abilities.desc: The fear smith has advantage on saving throws against being blinded.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The fear smith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fear smith makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Heart-Stopping Stare.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage. If the target is disoriented by Distortion Gaze, the fear smith regains hp equal to the amount of psychic damage dealt.

actions.name: Heart-Stopping Stare
actions.desc: The fear smith terrifies a creature within 30 feet of it with a look. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 13 (3d8) psychic damage and be stunned until the end of its next turn. The fear smith regains hp equal to the psychic damage dealt.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The fear smith casts one of the following spells, requiring no verbal or material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At will: detect thoughts, fear
2/day each: charm person, command

name: Felid Dragon
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 13

abilities.name: Flyby
abilities.desc: The felid dragon doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

abilities.name: Keen Smell
abilities.desc: The felid dragon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The felid dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.desc: If the felid dragon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the felid dragon can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The felid dragon can use its Deafening Roar. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage, and, if the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns as a piece of the claw breaks off in the wound. Each time the dragon hits the target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound each round increases by 3 (1d6). Any creature can take an action to remove the claw with a successful DC 16 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The claw pops out of the wound if the target receives magical healing.

actions.name: Deafening Roar
actions.desc: Each creature within 60 feet of the dragon and that can hear it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be deafened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Deafening Roar for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Sickening Bile (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The dragon coughs up partially digested food and slimy bile in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 70 (20d6) poison damage and is coated in bile. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't coated in bile. While coated in bile, a creature is poisoned. A creature, including the target coated in bile, can use its action to remove the bile, ending the poisoned condition.

name: Fell Nightmare
languages: understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can't speak

abilities.name: Evil
abilities.desc: The nightmare radiates an Evil aura.

abilities.name: Fiery Hooves
abilities.desc: The nightmare sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The nightmare leaves charred hoofprints.

abilities.name: Fiery Trail
abilities.desc: When the nightmare moves along the ground, it can choose to leave behind a trail of fire 10 feet wide and 10 feet tall, which lasts until the beginning of the nightmares next turn. A creature that begins its turn in the fire or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 10 (3d6) fire damage. The trail ignites flammable objects.

abilities.name: Fire Resistance
abilities.desc: The nightmare can grant fire resistance to a rider.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.desc: The nightmare gains telepathy with a range of 120 feet. It can telepathically communicate with the fiend that trained it over any distance as long as they are on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. The nightmare can move through the space of a prone creature as long as it does not end its turn there.

actions.name: Ethereal Shift
actions.desc: The nightmare and a rider magically pass from the Ethereal Plane to the Material Plane or vice versa.

name: Fellforged
conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
languages: the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Construct Nature
abilities.desc: The fellforged doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

abilities.name: Inhabiting Spirit
abilities.desc: The fellforged is inhabited and animated by a specter. If the fellforged fails a saving throw against an effect that turns undead, the specter is expelled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the fellforged with the hp total it had before it was expelled. The specter otherwise uses the statistics of a specter.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the fellforged has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fellforged makes two Necrotic Slam attacks.

actions.name: Necrotic Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

bonusActions.name: Burst Gears
bonusActions.desc: The specter within the fellforged strains the construct's body, sending broken springs and gears flying. Each creature within 5 feet of the fellforged must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each time the fellforged uses this bonus action, its speed is reduced by 5 feet, and it can't use this bonus action if its speed is 0. Its speed returns to normal when it finishes a long rest.

abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
abilities.desc: The fennec fox has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Enchanted Cage
abilities.desc: The savant is immune to damage and can't be the target of spells or effects as long as its cage exists. The cage has a flying speed of 30 feet while the savant is inside of it, moving at the mental command of the savant. When the cage is destroyed, the savant floats gently to the ground. The cage has AC 19, 75 hp, and is immune to piercing, poison, and psychic damage. A non-derro that touches the cage or hits it with a melee weapon attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage and be frightened until the end of its next turn. The cage disintegrates if exposed to sunlight for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Maddening Babble
abilities.desc: The savant constantly babbles eldritch nonsense while it can see any non-derro creatures and isn't incapacitated. Each non-derro creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the savant and can hear the babbling must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated until the start of its next turn.

abilities.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
abilities.desc: The savant takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn outside the cage and in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fetal savant makes two Psychic Burst attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Burst
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) psychic damage.

actions.name: Soul Exchange (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The savant exchanges its soul with one Humanoid it can see within 20 feet of it. Its body becomes paralyzed, the target's soul inhabits the savant's paralyzed body, and the savant inhabits the target's body, taking full control of it. The savant retains its alignment, its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, its Psychic Burst action, and its immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

name: Fext
resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 20 ft., passive Perception 14
languages: the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Eldritch Weapons
abilities.desc: The fext's weapon attacks are magical. When the fext hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d8 force damage (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The fext has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Patron's Blessing
abilities.desc: While the fext is conscious and wearing no armor and wielding no shield, it adds its Charisma modifier to its AC (included above).

abilities.name: Undead Nature
abilities.desc: The fext doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fext makes two Eldritch Blade or Eldritch Fury attacks.

actions.name: Eldritch Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Fury
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Patron's Might (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The fext channels its patron's awe-inspiring presence, terrifying those nearby. Each creature within 10 feet of the fext must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (10d6) psychic damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.desc:
The fey drake's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). The fey drake can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components
At will: charm person, color spray, grease
3/day each: hypnotic pattern, locate creature, suggestion
1/day each: dominate person, polymorph

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The fey drake has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Superior Invisibility
abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the fey drake can magically turn invisible until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the drake wears or carries is invisible with it.

actions.name: Bewildering Breath
actions.desc: The drake breaths a plume of purple gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. While charmed, the creature can't take bonus actions or reactions, and it makes all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma skill checks and saving throws with disadvantage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fey drake makes three bite attacks.

abilities.name: Faerie Form
abilities.desc: The knight can magically change its size between Medium and Tiny as an action. While tiny, the bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by the knights attacks is halved. Additionally, it has disadvantage on Strength checks and advantage on Dexterity checks. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

abilities.name: Faerie Light
abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the knight can cast dim light for 30 feet, or extinguish its glow.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The knight makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Glittering Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold  fire  or lightning damage (its choice).

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points  the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour  even if it regains hit points  and it is asleep while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Fey Glamour
actions.desc: The knight targets one humanoid within 30 feet. The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is magically charmed by the knight for 1 day. If the knight or one of the knights allies harms the target  the target repeats the saving throw  ending the effect on itself on a success. If a targets saving throw is successful  or if the effect ends for it  the creature is immune to this knights Fey Charm for a year and a day.

reactions.name: Natures Shield
reactions.desc: When the knight would be hit by an attack while the knight is within 5 feet of a tree or other large plant, the knights AC magically increases by 3 against that attack as the plant interposes branches or vines between the knight and the attacker.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The fey revenant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Shadow Sight
abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fey revenant's darkvision.

abilities.name: Shadow Traveler (4/Day)
abilities.desc: As a bonus action while in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the fey revenant disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at its origin and destination when it uses this trait.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.desc: The fey revenant can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the fey revenant has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Thorn Body
abilities.desc: A creature that touches the fey revenant or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fey revenant makes three attacks, either with its shortsword or longbow. It can use its Queen's Grasp in place of one shortsword or longbow attack.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 120/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Queen's Grasp
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, ranged 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: The target is restrained by icy wisps of shadow. While restrained, the creature takes 7 (2d6) cold damage at the start of each of its turns. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 15 Strength check, bursting through the icy shadow on a success. The icy shadow can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; 5 hp; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; immunity to cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage).

name: Feyward Tree
resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t speak

abilities.name: Aversion to Cold
abilities.desc: If the feyward tree takes cold damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

abilities.name: Construct Nature
abilities.desc: The feyward tree doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

abilities.name: Enchanted Leaves
abilities.desc: The feyward tree's Razor-Leafed Branch attacks are magical. When the tree hits with its Razor-Leafed Branch, the branch deals an extra 9 (2d8) force damage (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Immutable Form
abilities.desc: The feyward tree is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

abilities.name: Lightning Absorption
abilities.desc: Whenever the feyward tree is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hp equal to the lightning damage dealt.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance

name: Fidele Angel
resistances: fire, lightning, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

abilities.name: Ever Connected
abilities.desc: Fidele angels are magically connected. Damage taken by the fidele angel is split evenly between the fidele angel and its paired fidele angel. The angel that was the original target of the attack takes any damage that won't divide evenly. All other effects, such as reducing ability scores or being the target of a bless spell, affect only the target.

abilities.name: Immortal Nature
abilities.desc: The fidele angel doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Magic Weapons
abilities.desc: The angel's weapon attacks are magical.

abilities.name: Unshakeable Fidelity
abilities.desc: No spell, feature, trait, magic, or other effect can cause a fidele angel to act against or harm its mate or change its love or loyalty toward its mate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fidele angel makes three Longsword or Radiant Bolt attacks. Alternatively, it makes one Beak attack and two Talons attacks.

actions.name: Longsword (Humanoid or True Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Beak (Bird Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons (Bird Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) radiant damage.

actions.desc: If its mate is more than 1 mile away from it, the fidele angel can magically teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of its mate. The angel can use this action even if its mate is on another plane of existence.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The angel casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At will: detect evil and good, purify food and drink, spare the dying
3/day each: bless, cure wounds, daylight

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.desc: The fidele angel transforms into a Medium or smaller Humanoid, a Large or smaller birdlike Beast, or back into its true form, which is a winged Celestial. Without wings, it loses its flying speed. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

name: Fierstjerren
conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, unconscious

abilities.name: Apotheosis
abilities.desc: When the fierstjerren has 80 hp or fewer, the spirit within it tears free and tendrils of necrotic energy erupt from its skin. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. When it has 60 hp or fewer, its weapon attacks instead deal an extra 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. When it has 40 hp or fewer, its weapon attacks instead deal an extra 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

abilities.name: Thrall Watch
abilities.desc: A fierstjerren with thralls can't be surprised and attacks from hiding don't gain advantage against it.

actions.desc: The fierstjerren targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the creature can see the fierstjerren, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the fierstjerren's next turn.

actions.name: Thrall Enslavement
actions.desc: The fierstjerren targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it that has a CR up to 1/2. The humanoid must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the fierstjerren. The fierstjerren can telepathically communicate with any creature it has charmed. The charmed target can't take reactions and obeys the fierstjerren's verbal and telepathic commands. A fierstjerren can have up to twelve charmed thralls at one time. A charmed thrall loses the memories of its previous life and devotes itself to the fierstjerren and the cult. The charm lasts for 24 hours or until the fierstjerren is destroyed, is more than 300 feet from the charmed target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect. The fierstjerren can attempt to reassert control over all of its thralls by using this action. Each thrall can repeat the saving throw when the fierstjerren uses this action to reassert control.

abilities.name: Fire Form

abilities.name: Water Weakness
abilities.desc: The elemental takes 6 (1d12) cold damage if it enters a body of water or starts its turn in a body of water, is splashed with at least 5 gallons of water, or is hit by a water elementals slam attack.

actions.name: Slam

actions.name: Wildfire

When a creature shares its space with the elemental for the first time during this movement  the creature is subject to the elementals Fiery Aura and the elemental can make a slam attack against that creature.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Pillar of Flame
actions.desc: Each creature within a 10-foot-radius  40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within 60 feet that the fire giant can see makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw  taking 56 (16d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. Unattended flammable objects are ignited.

reactions.name: Kick

name: Fire Imp

abilities.name: Devil's Sight

abilities.name: Fire Absorption

abilities.name: Heat Metal (1/Day)

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Fire Touch

actions.name: Hurl Flame

name: Firebird

abilities.name: Enforce Good Deeds
abilities.desc: A creature that has received assistance, such as healing or a glowing feather, from the firebird must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the geas spell for 30 days. While under the geas, the affected creature must assist nonhostile creatures suffering from starvation or thirst by alleviating the starvation or thirst.

abilities.name: Fiery Weapons
abilities.desc: The firebird's weapon attacks are magical. When the firebird hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d6 fire damage (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Glowing Feathers

If the firebird willingly gifts a feather to a creature, the feather sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet indefinitely.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The firebird has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Warming Presence
abilities.desc: The firebird and each creature within 5 feet of it are immune to the effects of cold environments, provided the cold is caused by naturally occurring weather and climate. When the firebird is inside a structure, it can choose for this trait to affect all creatures within the structure (no action required), regardless of how close they are to it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The firebird makes one Beak attack and one Talon attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Talon

actions.name: Blinding Ray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The firebird fires a burning ray of light from its tail feathers in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 17 (5d6) fire damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded.

actions.name: Healing Feathers (3/Day)
actions.desc: The firebird touches another creature, brushing its wings against the creature. The target magically regains 10 (3d6) hp and is freed from any disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

abilities.name: Magical Light Sensitivity
abilities.desc: While in an area of light created by a spell or other magical effect, the firegeist has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

abilities.name: Variable Illumination
abilities.desc: The firegeist sheds dim light in a 5- to 20-foot radius. It can alter the radius as a bonus action.

abilities.name: Water Susceptibility

Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't frightened. While frightened, the creature takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

abilities.name: Massive Bulk
abilities.desc: A flab giant can't take the Dash action. In addition, a creature attempting to grapple, push, or knock the giant prone has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks to do so.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Squatting Pin
actions.desc: One creature grappled by the flab giant must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 22 (5d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and is restrained until the grapple ends. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't restrained, but it remains grappled until it escapes.
